import Foundation

/// Operations tagged `Agents`.
public struct AgentsAPI: Sendable {
    let client: UARPClient

    init(client: UARPClient) { self.client = client }

    /// Shortens to `create`
    ///
    /// `POST /agents`
    public func create(body: CreateAgentRequest, options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> JSONValue {
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "POST",
            path: "/agents",

            options: options
        ))
    }

    /// Shortens to `list`
    ///
    /// `GET /agents`
    public func list(options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> JSONValue {
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "GET",
            path: "/agents",
            options: options
        ))
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Operations tagged `Runs`.
public struct RunsAPI: Sendable {
    let client: UARPClient

    init(client: UARPClient) { self.client = client }

    /// `DELETE /runs/{runId}`
    public func delete(runId: String, options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws {
        try await client.sendVoid(RequestSpec(
            method: "DELETE",
            path: "/runs/\(encodePathSegment(runId))",
            options: options
        ))
    }

    /// `GET /runs/{runId}`
    public func getRun(runId: String, options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> JSONValue {
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "GET",
            path: "/runs/\(encodePathSegment(runId))",
            options: options
        ))
    }

    /// Collides with getRun after shortening, so both keep their ids
    ///
    /// `GET /runs/latest`
    public func getRuns(options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> JSONValue {
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "GET",
            path: "/runs/latest",
            options: options
        ))
    }

    /// Must keep its full name: `listAgent` would lie
    ///
    /// `GET /agents/{agentId}/runs`
    public func listAgentRuns(agentId: String, options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> JSONValue {
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "GET",
            path: "/agents/\(encodePathSegment(agentId))/runs",
            options: options
        ))
    }
}

extension UARPClient {
    /// Operations tagged `Runs`.
    public var runs: RunsAPI { RunsAPI(client: self) }
}
